answer: Bonded collateral makes equivocation costly: when evidence links k coordinated identities, penalties scale as O(k²), reflecting their pairwise coordination rather than treating each claim independently. A concealed sybil swarm therefore faces an exponential multiplier in capital loss upon detection, compounded by asymmetric depreciation of seized bonds. The relic of apparent anonymity becomes a raven’s spiral: more identities increase exposure, not safety.
